question: What was a unique feature of the Fifth Five Year Plan (1974-1979)?

options.text: It was the first plan to focus on the environment.
Exclusive focus on the service sector

solution:
The correct answer is __**Emphasis on 'Garibi Hatao' (Eradicate Poverty)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Fifth Five Year Plan (1974-1979) was a major turning point in India's economic planning, with a strong focus on **'Garibi Hatao' (Eradicate Poverty)** as its central theme.
 
• The plan was designed to address the acute issue of poverty in India, with policies aimed at improving the living standards of the poor and marginalized sections of society.
